Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Lalit Belwal, Mr. Vipul Sharma and Mr. Ashish 
Belwal, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. S.S. Lingwal, learned counsel for the 
respondents-University, through video conferencing. 
3. It is contended on behalf of learned counsel for the 
petitioner that his service were terminated based on the 
preliminary enquiry report submitted by the Internal 
Complaints Committee and neither charge sheet was 
issued to the petitioner nor petitioner was supplied copy of 
the complaint made by the complainant.
4. It is further contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that without holding any disciplinary enquiry 
petitioner’s services were terminated. 
5. Learned counsel for the respondents-University is 
given a week’s time for filing supplementary counter 
affidavit giving reply to the said contention.
6. List this case on 24.04.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
